# Golden DigiNet frames, one whole Ethernet frame per line: a name, a space, the bytes in hex
# (padding included). Built by hand from docs/protocol.md; tests/test_frame.c and
# tests/ksy/check_golden.py both read this file and assert the values that file gives.
#
# Desk MAC 00:a0:7e:24:00:01 (Digidesign OUI), ProControl 00:a0:7e:08:00:01, host MAC
# 02:00:00:00:00:01 (locally administered). Counters are arbitrary but distinct.
#
# announce_cntrl24          e0 broadcast, length 50, version "1.37", name "CNTRL|24"
# announce_session_cntrl24  e1 broadcast naming the host; the host MAC is placed at body
#                           offset 0 because no source says where it sits (an assumption)
# announce_mainunit         e0 from a ProControl, name "MAINUNIT"
# wake / disconnect         e2 / e3, no body, length 16
# keepalive                 body 00, one command, length 17, sum sent as zero
# ack                       a0 acknowledging desk send_counter 0x105
# fader_move                desk: B0 00 40 20 00, fader 1 at 512
# button_mute               desk: 90 08 40, strip 1 MUTE pressed
# scribble_write            host: F0 13 01 40 00 00 "OMX1" F7
# meter                     host: F0 13 01 10 00 07 7F F7, strip 1 left, ten segments
# clock_init                host: F0 13 01 30 19 00x8 F7 with sum 0x0244
# running_status            desk: 90 08 40 | 07 41 | B0 01 7F | 21 70 | 40 41 | 5C 3F, then
#                           two stale padding bytes 5A 5A that are not part of the body;
#                           five commands (the fader's MSB and LSB are one, A7)
# desk_retry                desk retransmits 90 08 00 with retry = 1
announce_cntrl24 ffffffffffff00a07e240001885f0032032e00000000000000000000e000000000000000000000000000000000312e33370000000000434e54524c7c32340000
